entry.title: a short note about debugging
entry.content:
I spent a while getting debugging wrong. Here is the version that works for me.

why it matters

Debugging shows up across programming work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

entry.title: what i learned about debugging
entry.content:
Short post: debugging is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Debugging shows up across programming work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
